macros.name: aboveoutlskip
macros.doc: Two lengths, \aboveoutlskip and \belowoutlskip, initially set to the equivalent values for math displays, are used to separate an outline environment from the surrounding text.

macros.name: belowoutlskip
macros.doc: Two lengths, \aboveoutlskip and \belowoutlskip, initially set to the equivalent values for math displays, are used to separate an outline environment from the surrounding text.

macros.name: labelfont
macros.doc: The labels themselves are typeset in \labelfont, which can also be set by the user.

macros.name: outlindent
macros.doc: The \outlindent macro controls the increment between adjacent outline levels.

macros.name: unpp
macros.doc: The \unpp macro does not indent the first line of text.
